hero.title: Our Events
hero.description: Breakfasts, receptions and roundtables that bring media professionals together.

intro.title: Our Events
intro.body: We host relaxed, invite-only breakfasts, receptions and roundtables for senior media, broadcast and technology professionals. Each event is designed to create space for real conversations, not just business cards.

events.details: This invite-only breakfast brings together senior leaders from broadcasters, studios and technology companies attending IBC. Expect an informal, facilitated conversation over coffee and breakfast, with plenty of time to connect with peers before the show floor opens.
events.summary: NAB 2026, unpacked. An expert analysis of the show’s defining technology and trends. Join us for brunch, refreshments, networking, and panel discussions.
events.title: NAB Review
events.description: Join us for a relaxed breakfast at IBC to discuss trends, challenges and opportunities in media and broadcast.

events.details: Hosted upstairs at the Hand and Flower, this reception is an opportunity to unwind after a busy day and catch up with familiar faces and new contacts. We’ll provide drinks, light food and some gentle facilitation to make introductions easy and natural.
events.summary: The show continues at The Hand and Flower. Our signature reception just steps from Olympia. Join us for refreshments and the industry's go-to social.
events.title: MPTS Reception
events.description: An evening reception for media leaders to reconnect, share experiences and meet new collaborators.

events.details: This intimate summit brought together product, operations and technology leaders to share practical experiences with AI in scheduling, playout, personalisation and production workflows. Sessions combined short talks with small-group discussions and feedback.
events.summary: Make the journey part of IBC. An exclusive Eurostar carriage hosted by Greenline. Enjoy a high-speed journey to Amsterdam with live music, refreshments, and networking.
events.title: The Greenline to IBC
events.description: A half-day summit exploring how AI is reshaping broadcast operations and audience experiences.
